name: 麦克林·麦卡蒂
bio_short: 美国遗传学家，艾弗里团队中最年轻的成员。他与艾弗里和麦克劳德共同完成了著名的“艾弗里-麦克劳德-麦卡蒂实验”（`avery_dna_principle_1944`），通过酶解技术确凿地证明了DNA是遗传信息的载体。
bio_short_en: An American geneticist and the youngest member of Avery's team. Together with Avery and MacLeod, he conducted the famous 'Avery-MacLeod-McCarty experiment' (`avery_dna_principle_1944`), conclusively proving via enzymatic digestion that DNA is the carrier of genetic information.
